notes:
**Board comments: count dot clicked, read-only thread list** (CHR-1260 / CHR-1261). The dot of init-project-dialog is active (`comment-count-chip` variant `dot-active`).

**`comment-preview` variant `list`:** the header holds the screen name, "N open" and a close button. The body is a `role="list"` of `comment-thread-row`s, one per open thread, newest activity first. Each row shows the thread number, styled like its pin (human/agent colour; detached rows dashed amber with the node struck through), the node id, the time of the last message, and the last message clamped to one line with an "author:" prefix. The list scrolls inside the popover from 6 rows (max-height ≈ 6 rows). The footer reads "Click a thread to open it" and holds "Open in Screens" (opens the screen without a thread).

**Click on a row:** opens that thread in the Screens view (screen selected, thread popover open → `comments-panel`). Rows are buttons (Enter/Space), and arrow keys move between rows (roving tabindex). Close, Esc and light dismiss work as in the single-thread preview, and focus returns to the dot.

Popover and anchor positioning are as described in `board-comments-preview`: `position-area: block-end span-inline-end`, `position-try-fallbacks: flip-inline, flip-block`, `@supports` gate plus a JS fallback.
